summary: Depth on NSE cash, the book first (audit RB-04): a MarketDepthService frame before any MarketFeedV3 frame gives the book and its totals and no quote field; after the quote, the next book carries it.

notes: DEPTH and FEED are the web test's frames.

deviations.reason: A depth frame keeps ltp and timestamp before the instrument's first quote, for every broker (1.0.6 decision: the SDK's Depth callback reads them); the 5paisa web adapter leaves ltp out of a MarketDepthService frame that comes before any MarketFeedV3 frame (audit RB-04). The other quote fields are left out on both.
deviations.ref: CLAUDE.md (a depth frame before its instrument's first tick); feed/bridge.rs depth_update; fivepaisa_adapter.py:_normalize_market_data mode 3

deviations.reason: The desktop pads each side of 5paisa's book to five levels with zero levels (FivepaisaFeed depth_book, v.resize(5, ..)), so a book of one bid and one ask, or an empty book, goes out as five levels a side; the web sends the levels 5paisa sent (_extract_depth_data), and rules.md says no padded book. Desktop defect.

The 5paisa web adapter passes 5paisa's JSON number on as it came, so a whole price (the web test's OpenRate 445) goes out as an integer (445) where the desktop sends a float (445.0). Same value, another JSON type: follows the web adapter in Phase B through lane wire's per-broker number types (5paisa: a price keeps the type of the frame's value).

The desktop sends price_change on an equity or a future (ltp less the previous close: feed/dialect/names.rs gives 5paisa instrument_change); the 5paisa web adapter sends ChgPcnt as percent_change only, which the desktop sends too. Follows the web adapter in Phase B: 5paisa's dialect entry without instrument_change.

The desktop sends price_change_percent (5paisa's ChgPcnt) on an equity or a future beside percent_change (feed/dialect/names.rs gives 5paisa instrument_change); the 5paisa web adapter sends percent_change only. Follows the web adapter in Phase B: 5paisa's dialect entry without instrument_change.
